001: Do you have a moment to go over my schedule for the week?
Sure, let's take a look at it right now. Which day are you worried about?
On Tuesday I have three meetings in a row and I don't know how to organize myself.
I see, that's too much. We could move the last one to first thing Thursday morning.
That sounds good to me, that way I'll have time to prepare the reports.
Perfect, I'll write it down and confirm the change by email.
002: I need to ask you a favor with tomorrow's schedule.
Tell me, what do you need to change?
I have an appointment with the client at ten, but I've been called in for a doctor's appointment.
Wow, that's bad luck. Do you want me to move it to four in the afternoon?
Yes, please, that would work great for me.
Alright, I'll talk to her secretary and let you know as soon as I confirm it.
003: How's the planning for next week going?
Honestly, it's pretty packed, I have a lot of pending tasks.
Do you want me to help you prioritize the most urgent ones?
I'd really appreciate that, I don't know where to start.
We can start with Monday's presentation and leave the rest for later.
You're right, that's the most important one. Thanks for the help.
004: I had to cancel this afternoon's meeting, did you get the notice?
Yes, I saw it, but I haven't received the new proposed date.
It's just that I haven't set it yet. How about Wednesday at nine?
Wednesday morning I'm free, so that works perfectly for me.
Then I'll confirm it for Wednesday at nine.
Great, I'll write it down in my schedule right now.
005: Sorry, I think I got the time wrong for our appointment.
Oh, really? I had written down that it was at two.
No, it was at one, but something came up and I arrived late.
Don't worry, I didn't wait long. Shall we get started?
Yes, thanks for your patience. I apologize again.
No problem, these things happen. Let's get to the point.
006: Can you recommend an app to manage time better?
I use one called Easy Schedule and it works really well for me.
Really? And is it complicated to use?
Not at all, it's very intuitive and it reminds you about each meeting in advance.
Well, I'll try it out this weekend.
Go ahead, and if you need help setting it up, just let me know.
007: Work has piled up and I don't know how to organize my afternoons.
What works for me is dividing tasks into two-hour blocks.
And do you manage to get everything done that way?
Almost always, and I also have time left to rest.
Well, I'll try your method next week.
You'll see how much it helps you, it completely changed my routine.
008: Can we move Friday's meeting up to first thing?
I'm sorry, but Friday morning I have another appointment outside the office.
Thursday afternoon I'm definitely available, no problem.
Perfect, I'll change it in the schedule and let the others know.
Thanks for being so flexible with the times.
009: I've booked a room for the presentation, but I'm not sure if it's the right one.
How many people do you need it for?
There will be about fifteen of us, and we need a projector.
Then the main room is the best option, it has all the equipment.
Can you book it for me for Tuesday at eleven?
Sure, I'll reserve it and send you the confirmation.
010: I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed with this month's delivery deadlines.
I can imagine, you have a lot of projects on your plate.
Do you think I should ask a coworker for help?
I think that's a good idea, that way you split the workload.
You're right, I'll talk to the boss to see if it's possible.
Do it, I'm sure he'll support you if you explain the situation well.
